text:
Grace Lin: Heads up — DataForge got an invoice tonight where the prorated usage line was negative and the customer-facing total is wrong. Looks like a pricing experiment leak?
Omar Aziz: Invoice id? single-customer or batch?
Grace Lin: INV-2026-01357, single run in the nightly targeted-billing job. Gen output below, seems the pro-rata factor was -1.2 somehow: 
```
{"id":"INV-2026-01357","customer":"DataForge","lines":[{"desc":"subscription (Jun)","amount_cents":600000},{"desc":"prorated usage","amount_cents":-720000},{"desc":"tax","amount_cents":30000}],"total_cents":-90000}
```
Invoice Bot: billing-renderer: failed to generate PDF for INV-2026-01357 at 2026-06-12T04:02:11Z error="subtotal negative: -90000" job=br-20260612-09
Priya Shah: That negative prorate smells like the pricing experiment `pricing-v2` that changed proration multiplier. Eng rollout had a canary last night. Was that flag ON for targeted-billing?
Eng Billing: Confirmed: experiments svc toggled `pricing-v2` -> rollout=10% at 2026-06-12T03:58:00Z and targeted-billing was in the 10% cohort. ops logs: experiments: toggle pricing-v2 id=exp-332 cohort=targeted-billing job=exp-20260612-3
Omar Aziz: Immediate: hold emails, pause experiment cohort, and re-run invoice generation using the stable proration. Need finance lead approval to mutate ledger if we regenerate.
Grace Lin: Approved. Please pause and fix. :white_check_mark:
Eng Billing: Running recovery steps: 
```
# disable experiment for targeted-billing cohort
expctl toggle --id exp-332 --cohort targeted-billing --state off
# regenerate invoice with stable proration logic
billing-cli invoice regenerate --id INV-2026-01357 --proration-mode stable --force
```
Eng Billing: Regenerate result: `\{"id\":\"INV-2026-01357\",\"customer\":\"DataForge\",\"lines\":[{\"desc\":\"subscription (Jun)\",\"amount_cents\":600000},{\"desc\":\"prorated usage\",\"amount_cents\":30000},{\"desc\":\"tax\",\"amount_cents\":12300}],\"total_cents\":642300\}`
Invoice Bot: mailer-service: held email for INV-2026-01357 earlier; re-sent corrected invoice to billing@dataforge.com at 2026-06-12T04:15:33Z
Priya Shah: Filing ENG-5478: "pricing experiment `pricing-v2` leaked into billing cohort -> negative proration" with logs, repro steps, and mitigation: add server-side validation to reject negative prorate multipliers. Assign to @eng-billing and @eng-experiments, severity=P1.
Grace Lin: Notifying support to hold customer outreach and will follow up with affected customers list.
Omar Aziz: Closing thread for now. Re-open if disputes surface or more invoices affected. :lock:
